Hans Zimmer Live in Phoenix, March 30, 2027: Mortgage Matchup Center parking and the ride

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: Hans Zimmer Live – The Next Level plays Mortgage Matchup Center in downtown Phoenix on Tuesday, March 30, 2027, at 7:00 p.m. on the arena’s page. Parking is in nearby garages bought ahead on ParkWhiz, bags must fit 14 by 14 by 6 inches, and the drop-off is on 3rd Street. For a group, one chauffeured vehicle covers dinner, the show and the ride home.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

When is Hans Zimmer in Phoenix?

Hans Zimmer Live – The Next Level plays Mortgage Matchup Center in downtown Phoenix on Tuesday, March 30, 2027. The arena’s event page lists the start at 7:00 p.m.; Live Nation’s listing says 7:30 p.m., so plan for 7:00 and check the arena’s page closer to the date. Zimmer performs with his 19-piece band. The arena, formerly Footprint Center, is at 201 East Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004.

Where do you park for Hans Zimmer at Mortgage Matchup Center?

In the garages and lots within walking distance, bought ahead through ParkWhiz as the arena advises. Event parking generally opens about 30 minutes before doors and there is no in-and-out; the arena does not publish a doors time for this show yet. Our Mortgage Matchup Center guide has the garages, the light rail and the full parking answer.

Where is the drop-off for Hans Zimmer Live?

On 3rd Street just south of Jefferson, at the green curb: the arena’s drop-off and pickup for events. No vehicle may wait there, so we unload, clear the curb and come back when the group is together after the show.

What can you bring to Hans Zimmer Live?

Bags must fit within 14 by 14 by 6 inches and backpacks are not allowed, as the event page states. Professional cameras and audio or video recording devices are prohibited. Leave the extras in the vehicle: with a booked ride it waits nearby, and nobody walks back to a garage.

How should a group plan the Hans Zimmer night?

Plan the pickup back from the 7:00 p.m. start on the arena’s page, with time for dinner downtown first. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for dinner, the show and the ride home, or book a ride there and a ride back. It suits a quieter cabin as well as a party one: the Maybach Jet or the Suburban for a couple, the Party Sprinter for a crew.

Is Candlelight’s Best of Hans Zimmer the same concert as Hans Zimmer Live?

No. Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer, held at the Phoenix Zoo and other Phoenix venues, is a tribute concert played by a string quartet, and its organizer, Fever, says it is not affiliated with the artist. Hans Zimmer himself plays Hans Zimmer Live – The Next Level at Mortgage Matchup Center on Tuesday, March 30, 2027. The arena’s page puts Zimmer on stage with his 19-piece band. Buy from the arena’s event page, and check that the ticket names Hans Zimmer Live – The Next Level and Mortgage Matchup Center. The arena box office at 201 East Jefferson Street sells tickets too, delivered to your phone. On a weekday event it opens at 3 p.m.

Which vehicle fits a group going to Hans Zimmer Live?

Our pick for Hans Zimmer Live is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, seating 15. A VIP night takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter (9 seats), the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban); a friend crew takes the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) or the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax); a big group takes the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28 seats). The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter has fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes, lasers and a fog machine, an ultra-premium sound system and a partition with an intercom to your chauffeur. The Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum; the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax, so one more rider does not change it. For a quieter ride, the Executive Black Sprinter seats 14 in reclining black leather, and the Luxury SUV (Suburban) is black on black for a couple.
